address: Asterweg 17-19, Amsterdam-Noord (Buiksloterham): 2006 brick office-and-workshop block with a raised brick storey carried over an open steel-truss ground floor
notes: Asterweg 17-19 (BAG, 2006; Buiksloterham): a brick workshop-and-office block whose raised upper storey is carried over an open ground floor on diagonal steel trusses. 116 3DBAG wall surfaces; the east front (panel 0, w02-74, 2021-06-16, 60 m) is the only street front with a panorama within 35 m, the rest stays blank (otherWalls).

walls[0] = panel 0: a brick storey with a continuous ribbon of low windows under the eaves (the ASTERWEG 17 - 19 sign sits on the wall below it), over a ground floor that is glazed at the left end and an open dark arcade with galvanised diagonal trusses to the right, closing in a brick ramp wall. Drawn as ribbon-windows, 2 storeys, 20 bays, ground storey blank brick with a glazed entrance in bay 1. Simplified: the open arcade and the truss legs (the wall is solid; steel bars under 3 cm and an open void cannot be cut into a 3DBAG wall), the glazed lobby beyond bay 1. Skipped: the ASTERWEG 17-19 wall lettering (the wall-mounted letters leave 32 m of open edge in the export).
Not drawn: north, west and south fronts and the 33 m tower parts (no panorama).
